title: 第19章 其实药丸也不一定得给我们吃
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
不得不说，厉行天炼化千年骨玉之后的体质提升实在太大。

    加上更加契合厉行天的修行功法。

    起码在炼气期修行进度上，厉行天的修行速度已经媲美拥有修仙天才词条的李应灵了。

    经过几天的加强修炼，厉行天也终于到了突破筑基期的时候了。

    此刻的他正盘坐好，面前放着精炼过的血食——看起来黏糊的暗红色浓稠血块。

    后续功法筑基之后，就不用如此麻烦的捕捉血食，筑基之后要做的便是炼化自身血肉。

    所以说起这个功法麻烦，其实也就炼气境界略显麻烦罢了。

    楚星尘略有不舍得将空间戒指之中剩余的所有灵石拿了出来，替厉行天构建了一个简单的聚灵阵，来提供足够的灵气顺利突破到筑基境。

    这是目前能拿出来的所有灵石了，现在算是真被徒弟榨干了。

    总觉得世上不可能还会有宗门比自己还穷了。

    此时的破庙内，李应灵正在小锅边上烧水，表情有些奇怪，似乎在期待着什么。

    宁芊芊在也已经换上了李应灵的衣服，淡蓝色的纹花编裙，虽然略显宽大，但好歹不是脏兮兮的破旧麻衣。

    有些洁癖李应灵狠是给宁芊芊搓了一遍澡，那日小屋里的水声从早上一直冲到了中午，时不时还能听见宁芊芊一声惨嚎，想来李应灵下手也重。

    效果也是斐然，起码宁芊芊看上去终于不是难民模样，配上这一套衣服，颇有一种贫民窟的小孩穿着公主服饰的既视感。

    不过穿上这套衣服的宁芊芊自然也有些不习惯，此刻她正小心翼翼的摆弄对她来说有些宽大的袖子，好让袖子不会被地面弄脏。

    虽然李应灵多次表示没有关系。

    不过即将突破筑基期的厉行天神色就不是那么好了，他面色沉重的看向李应灵以及那一口开始沸腾的锅中水。

    他深吸一口气，看向楚星尘，语气认真道：

    “师父，其实那些丹药不吃我也有把握。”

    “良药苦口。”楚星尘将最后一块灵石摆放到位，随着安放完成，数十块灵石开始发出光亮。

    “放心，我知道是我药的味道不太对，这次你放心，我已经研究过加入什么调味剂能让丹药入口美味无比！”

    “师父……你确定你说的是丹药，不是师姐啃剩的鸡腿？”

    楚星尘从空间戒指之中拿出之前剩余不多的正经灵植，还能够勉强炼一份：

    “你不相信我的炼丹技术，你也不能怀疑我的厨艺，爱徒。”

    回想起师父的厨艺，厉行天还是觉得这话有点说服力，于是目光望向师父，期待他能说到做到。
content_en:
It has to be said that Li Xingtian's physical improvement after refining the thousand-year bone jade was really great.

In addition, the cultivation techniques are more in line with Li Xingtian.

At least in terms of the progress of his cultivation during the Qi refining period, Li Xingtian's cultivation speed was already comparable to that of Li Yingling, who had the entry of genius for cultivating immortals.

After several days of intensive training, it was finally time for Li Xingtian to break through the foundation building stage.

At this moment, he was sitting cross-legged, with refined blood food in front of him - thick, dark red blood clots that looked sticky.

After the foundation is established with subsequent exercises, there is no need to go to such trouble to capture blood food. What one has to do after establishing the foundation is to refine one's own flesh and blood.

So when it comes to this technique being troublesome, it is actually only a little troublesome in the Qi refining realm.

Chu Xingchen reluctantly took out all the remaining spirit stones in the space ring and built a simple spirit gathering array for Li Xingtian to provide enough spiritual energy to successfully break through to the foundation-building realm.

These are all the spiritual stones that can be taken out at present, and now they are really drained by the apprentice.

I always feel that it is impossible for any sect in the world to be poorer than myself.

At this time, in the ruined temple, Li Yingling was boiling water beside a small pot, with a strange expression on his face, as if he was expecting something.

Ning Qianqian had already changed into Li Yingling's clothes, a light blue patterned skirt. Although it was a little baggy, it was not a dirty and shabby linen dress.

Li Yingling, who was a bit of a germaphobe, gave Ning Qianqian a hard bath. The sound of water in the hut lasted from morning to noon, and Ning Qianqian's screams could be heard from time to time. Li Yingling thought that Li Yingling was very harsh.

The effect is also remarkable. At least Ning Qianqian finally doesn't look like a refugee. With this set of clothes, she has the feeling of a child in a slum wearing a princess costume.

However, Ning Qianqian, who was wearing this suit, was naturally not used to it. At this moment, she was carefully playing with the sleeves, which were a bit too wide for her, so that they would not be stained by the ground.

Although Li Yingling said many times that it didn't matter.

However, Li Xingtian, who was about to break through the foundation building stage, didn't look so good. He looked at Li Yingling and the pot of water that started to boil with a heavy expression.

He took a deep breath, looked at Chu Xingchen, and said in a serious tone:

"Master, actually I am confident that I won't take those pills."

"Good medicine tastes bitter." Chu Xingchen placed the last spiritual stone in place. As the placement was completed, dozens of spiritual stones began to glow.

"Don't worry, I know it's the taste of my medicine that's not right. Don't worry this time, I've already researched what flavorings to add to make the medicine delicious!"

"Master...are you sure you are talking about the elixir and not the leftover chicken legs that Senior Sister gnawed on?"

Chu Xingchen took out the few remaining serious spiritual plants from the space ring, and was able to barely refine one:

"You don't believe in my alchemy skills, and you can't doubt my cooking skills, dear disciple."

Recalling the master's cooking skills, Li Xingtian still felt that these words were somewhat convincing, so he looked at the master, expecting him to do what he said.
